description: 80 synthetic challenge cases with Codex-authored expected outcomes fixed before execution; labels have not been independently human-validated. This is not a random SEC/news sample or a calibrated accuracy estimate. Source identities are supplied for the alignment test. Separate source-extraction probes test targeted recovery.
